messages:
priya: Quick heads-up: delegated service-account traffic is getting charged to the org bucket on the router, not the originating project. noticed during customer QA.
dave: ouch. which flow?
priya: flow: user creates SA in project-x, does token-exchange, calls /v1/chat. console usage shows org-default consumption.
lina: can you paste the token claim dump?
priya: ```
{"claims":{"org":"org-acme","project":"proj-x","delegated":true},"meta":{"exchange_path":"/v1/auth/exchange"}}
```
orpheus-bot: Incident check: no active incidents for auth-router.
dave: router precedence rule currently: if org claim exists -> attribute to org. we did that for admin cross-project keys.
lina: delegated SA is different: the caller intent is project-scoped. we should special-case delegated==true.
priya: proposal: attribution logic: if claims.delegated==true and claims.project present -> attribute to project. else fall back to org. keeps behavior for admin tokens.
dave: sounds right. engineering notes: small router patch + unit tests. need to surface the rule in console logs for debuggability.
lina: Console UX: add a small "Attribution" label on request details with explanation: "Project (delegated override)" or "Org (org claim)". also link to raw claims.
priya: telemetry: emit metric auth.attribution.{project,org}.increment and histogram for decision.latency. we'll want a dashboard to track pre/post change.
dave: i'll drop a PR for router change + tests: PR #1248. gonna include mock token exchange in e2e.
lina: i'll own console changes and dashboard panels. plan: create panel "delegated_attr_fallback_rate" and an alert if >0.5% fallback after 1h.
priya: canary plan?
dave: canary: deploy to 2 edge routers for 1 hour, monitor delegated_attr_fallback_rate and error rate. roll forward if stable. schedule at 03:00 UTC.
orpheus-bot: Deploy queued: auth-router v2.15 -> canary nodes: edge-13, edge-21 @ 03:00 UTC
priya: test checklist: 1) create SA in proj-x 2) exchange token 3) call API 4) verify project attribution 5) inspect console request detail shows rule and raw claims
lina: add trace tag auth.attribution.rule so support can filter traces.
dave: will add logs with correlation id and attribution_decision field.
priya: filing INF-4992 to track this and include QA results. tagging @support for post-rollout validation.
priya: thanks all :raised_hands:
